field_name: # This dataset evaluates the field-name-based PII detection
# using regex patterns. The detector matches field names
# - true_positive: Field should be detected as PII
# - true_negative: Field should NOT be detected as PII
# Date of Birth fields - True Positives (matches birth/dob/birthday)
# IP Address fields - True Positives (matches ip_address/remote_ip)
# Credit Card fields - True Positives (matches credit_card/card_number/ccn)
# Edge Cases - CamelCase and variant patterns
# CamelCase patterns that ARE detected (contain PII keywords)
# Field-name-based detection intentionally does not handle
# non-standard abbreviations to avoid false positives
# Boundary Tests - Fields that could be confused with PII
# Fields ending with PII-like terms that are NOT PII
# True Negatives - Should NOT be detected as PII
